description.en: Thin wrapper around CMND_REMOVE_PARTY — removes a party member, with explicit control over both the status-reset and position-lock flags (RemoveParty derives the lock flag automatically instead).
Param ID of the character to remove from the party.
Whether to reset the member's status.
Whether to lock the member's now-vacated position slot.
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Remove a party member without resetting status or locking their slot
RemovePartyCmnd("para_cp0001", false, false);
